hero.title: Team & expert network
hero.subtitle: SY'ONE is not limited to its two founders as the sole delivery resources. The firm relies on an activatable network of senior consultants and experts, selected for their level, specialization and ability to intervene quickly on targeted issues.

team.complement: The founders remain directly involved in framing, structural arbitrations and quality assurance of missions. They are the anchor point of the client relationship and ensure interventions remain consistent, demanding and results-oriented.

founders.name: Yassine Ziad
founders.bio: Expert in strategy, digital transformation, IT governance and complex program management. 18 years of experience in banking, with leadership responsibilities covering innovation, Digital Banking, IT production, budget management and structural program delivery.
founders.shortBio: 25 years of experience in strategy, digital transformation and IT governance within financial institutions.

founders.name: Youssef Zerrari
founders.bio: Expert in Digital Banking, architecture, technology, operating models and large-scale transformation. Executive career at leading financial institutions, with responsibilities in digital strategy, innovation, Digital Factory, Agile@Scale and customer success.
founders.shortBio: 20 years of experience in Digital Banking, architecture and large-scale transformation in leading institutions.
